Title: [LSJ]: Stone Travel and Path of Night

Messages.Author: Jeroen du Chatinier
Messages.Body:
A quick question that I would really like to get an LSJ-stamped answer
on :):

Suppose a Path of Night is in play and a Lasombra uses a Stone Travel
for the Obtenebration effect. Does he or does he not burn one blood to
gain +1 stealth?

From http://tinyurl.com/24vve I would deduce that he has to burn 1
blood, but it'd really help to get an incorrect/correct on this one.

Thanks in advance,

Jeroen du Chatinier

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. The card has no cost, so Path of Night isn't a factor.
The effect has a cost. Path of Night doesn't reduce that cost.
